title: Rider Terms: Fee Payer and Chargeable Scope for Cleaning and Damage Fees
content:
These conditions of the rider terms say who pays a Cleaning and Damage Fees charge, on which trips support may approve one, and which conditions are never charged. They apply identically at every fee level.

## Conditions

1. **Who pays.** The fee is charged to the rider who requested the trip, including for companions travelling on the request.
2. **Split fares.** A fee is not split among split-fare participants; it is charged in full to the requesting rider.
3. **Wayfare Shared trips.** Support may not approve a fee on a Wayfare Shared trip; Shared trips are referred to Trust and Safety instead.
4. **Conditions never charged.** The following are never charged at any level: muddy footprints; rain or snow water; loose crumbs under one spot; normal wear and tear; service animal shedding.
5. **Service animal shedding.** Hair or dander shed by a service animal is exempt from any fee.
6. **Other service animal messes.** A mess other than shedding left by a service animal may be charged at its level.

## The conditions at each level

| Fee level | Fee charged to | Split among split-fare participants | Support may approve a fee on a Wayfare Shared trip | Service animal shedding exempt | Non-shedding service animal mess chargeable at its level |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cleaning Fee Level 1 (Minor) | the requesting rider | No | No | Yes | Yes |
| Cleaning Fee Level 2 (Moderate) | the requesting rider | No | No | Yes | Yes |
| Cleaning Fee Level 3 (Significant) | the requesting rider | No | No | Yes | Yes |
| Cleaning Fee Level 4 (Major) | the requesting rider | No | No | Yes | Yes |
| Damage Fee (Interior Repair) | the requesting rider | No | No | Yes | Yes |
| Damage Fee (Exterior Repair) | the requesting rider | No | No | Yes | Yes |

The list of conditions never charged in clause 4 is the same at all six levels.

## Illustrations (hypothetical)

- Three friends share a Wayfare Comfort trip requested by one of them and split the fare; a companion leaves a spill. Any fee is charged in full to the friend who requested the trip, and nothing is split among the others.
- A driver reports only muddy footprints and rain water on the floor mats. Both are conditions never charged at any level.
